text:
Mara: quick thread to capture an idea about 'hinted' credits and finalizer races so i don't forget before the mini-rfc.
Sam: ok, what's the failure pattern?
Mara: when we emit compacted/sampled credits we sometimes don't have the canonical provenance yet. during consumer restarts/replays the same usage can be emitted twice or split across shards, creating double-charge or orphaned audit refs.
Tony: saw this in staging last week — dup credit for tenant=zephyr after ingest restart.
Lee: can you drop the log?
Mara: pasted: ```
2024-04-03T14:22:11Z ERROR reconcile duplicate credit tenant=zephyr token=tkn_42 shard=sh-9 attempt=2
2024-04-03T14:22:12Z INFO  handshake lease reacquired shard=sh-9 owner=ingest-a
```
Sam: two general fixes: (1) make the finalizer dedupe using a fingerprint store; (2) change credit schema to carry provenance state so downstreams can reconcile.
Tony: (1) is quicker: generate deterministic fingerprint = sha1(tenant|usage_root|seq) at ingress and check an at-most-once table at finalization.
Lee: at-scale concern: storing every fingerprint forever is infeasible. what's TTL?
Mara: proposal: keep the online map for 90d, export daily snapshots to warehouse for 12mo retention for audits.
Sam: hybrid approach: emit credits quickly with provenance_state="hint" and a fingerprint. finalizer will try to resolve hint -> canonical_provenance and flip state to "canonical". if unresolved after X hours, reconciliation job marks as "repaired" or emits corrections.
Tony: define conservative billing behavior: while state!=canonical, billing should not overcharge. either undercharge (and repair later) or mark as provisional with finance-visible flag.
Lee: finance insisted on stable IDs per charged unit. provisional-only might be acceptable if reflected in invoice UI and accompanied by SLA for canonicalization.
Mara: API shape i suggest: {credit_id, tenant_id, amount, fingerprint, provenance_state} where provenance_state is in ["hint","canonical","repaired"]. auditors can call mapping endpoint fingerprint->canonical_provenance_id.
Sam: implement sketch: 1) ingress generates fingerprint and emits hint credit. 2) finalizer runs claim/CAS on fingerprint row; winner writes canonical id. 3) finalizer patches emitted credits to canonical. 4) nightly reconcile fixes leftovers.
Tony: need CAS semantics: if two finalizers win concurrently, tie-break via instance-id or timestamp, but ensure idempotent upsert so ledger remains consistent.
Lee: reuse existing lease/handshake service to protect fingerprint claims. also add metrics for claim failures and contention.
Sam: also plan compensating credits: when reconciliation finds a duplicate billed twice, emit negative credit referencing original provenance to keep accounting append-only.
Mara: ops plan: canary tenants on hinted path (10%), monitor credits.duplicates, credits.enrichment_pending, billing.provisional_count for 48h, then increase. OpsBot: deploy-bot suggests rollout steps inline.
Tony: retention: online fingerprint map 90d; daily snapshot to S3/warehouse for 12mo. finance ok?
Lee: i'll sync with finance on retention and UI flags.
Sam: i'll draft mini-rfc including credit shapes, finalizer CAS pseudocode, metrics to track, and recon job contract. volunteers to review? @Tony @Lee
Tony: i'll take the finalizer/CAS review.
Lee: i'll own retention/export + finance conversation.
Mara: thanks — will PR later today. keep the mini-rfc focused with sequence diagrams for normal vs restart/replay flows.
